BiblicalUsage: Pil'i means wonderful, beyond understanding. The angel of the LORD tells Manoah his name is secret, too wonderful to ask, in Judges 13:18, and David says such knowledge is too wonderful for me in Psalms 139:6.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe some wonders are not puzzles to solve but glories to bow before.
RelatedTopics: Majesty of God; Knowledge of God
